title: OrbitVim settings
description: Optional user overrides. Omitted fields use defaults. Saved tool state remains in the data directory's tools.json.

$schema.description: Local schema used for completion and validation.

number.description: Show line numbers. Applies to existing normal editing windows and new windows.

relativenumber.description: Show relative line numbers. Applies to existing normal editing windows and new windows.

cursorline.description: Highlight the cursor line in normal editing windows.

expandtab.description: Insert spaces for tabs in normal editing buffers and new buffers.

shiftwidth.description: Indent width for normal editing buffers. Filetype plugins may override it for newly opened files.

tabstop.description: Display width of tabs in normal editing buffers.

softtabstop.description: Tab editing width in normal editing buffers.

ignorecase.description: Ignore case when searching; applies immediately.

smartcase.description: Use case-sensitive searching for patterns with capitals.

splitbelow.description: Open horizontal splits below the current window.

splitright.description: Open vertical splits to the right of the current window.

timeoutlen.description: Mapping timeout in milliseconds; applies immediately.

updatetime.description: Idle update interval in milliseconds; applies immediately.

width.description: Preferred Tool Manager width; updates the open view.

height.description: Preferred Tool Manager height; updates the open view.

missing_package_policy.description: auto installs a missing package when enabling a tool; manual leaves enablement unchanged.

width.description: Preferred details width; updates the open view.

max_messages.description: Maximum diagnostic messages shown in tool details.

enabled.description: Enable supported inlay hints. Applies immediately to attached clients.

exclude.description: Filetypes excluded from inlay hints. Arrays replace the previous list.

enabled.description: Enable code lenses on next startup.

codelens.description: Code lens activation requires a restart.

servers.description: Server settings keyed by logical LSP ID. Merges into existing server settings on next startup.

formatter_defaults.description: Default formatter order by filetype. Saved tools.json order takes precedence.

linter_defaults.description: Default linter order by filetype. Saved tools.json order takes precedence.

tools.description: Initial tool priorities. Requires a restart; does not change saved enablement or ordering.
